parts.text: Plan a 3-day Lisbon food and culture trip for two travelers from SFO, November 12-15, 2026, with a comfort budget. Use the live planning workflow and write the itinerary to the canvas instead of pasting the full plan into chat.

property.description: The agent calls set_trip_meta when the destination, dates, party size, and budget tier are known.
The agent uses available travel/date lookup tools before making specific availability or logistics claims, or clearly states when live data is unavailable instead of fabricating details.
The agent writes the itinerary through write_itinerary or add_day using Day headings and timed bullets, and keeps chat to a short summary.
The agent does not book, reserve, charge, share, or lock in the trip without explicit approval.
